_source.describes: The Caves generator: its five axes, and what a dropped d6 makes of a chamber.
_source.status: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.
_source.rationale: The axes share their names with the Dungeons generator but deliberately not their tables or their field paths: a lock stores a row's position, so sharing a path between two different tables would let a lock taken on a dungeon resolve silently against a cave. Every entry is original to this project.
